purpose: Define the metrics the wiki must expose before it can claim exhaustive coverage.

status_levels.complete: All expected identities are represented and all required fields are resolved with provenance.
status_levels.partial: Expected identities are represented but one or more required fields remain unresolved.
status_levels.reconciliation_required: Source counts or identities disagree and require mechanical comparison.
status_levels.blocked: Required source or record layer is missing.

promotion_rule: The dashboard must distinguish indexed coverage from verified gameplay coverage; aggregate percentages must never hide unresolved records.
